# Reach Orion

> Next-generation headless CMS architectures, bespoke digital flagships, and sub-second web experiences.

Reach Orion is an IT development studio delivering custom headless CMS platforms, websites, and SaaS MVPs. We engineer clean, decoupled architecture: fast to launch, simple to manage, and built to scale with sub-second performance (<0.4s LCP, <190ms TTFB).

## Core Capabilities & Services
- [Websites & Editorial Platforms](https://reachorion.net/#capabilities): Fast, SEO + AIO-ready platforms with Sanity.io, Payload 3.0, Next.js App Router, and React 18.
- [SaaS MVPs & App Frontends](https://reachorion.net/#capabilities): Rapid agile sprint delivery from validated idea to first paying users in weeks.
- [CMS Migration & Decoupled Architecture](https://reachorion.net/#capabilities): Zero-downtime replatforming from legacy WordPress or Drupal monoliths to modern headless stacks.
- [Ongoing Architecture Maintenance](https://reachorion.net/#capabilities): Ongoing engineering support with security patches and performance tuning.

## Architectural Topology & Audits
- [Decoupled Headless vs Legacy Monolith Architecture](https://reachorion.net/#architecture): Technical audit comparing API-first headless architectures against monolithic WordPress and Drupal.

## Selected Case Studies & Flagships
- [The Aranya Promenade](https://reachorion.net/#archive): Biophilic Luxury Retail Sanctuary built with Sanity Studio v3, Next.js App Router, and interactive 3D WebGL canvas.
- [The Quarter Sea Face](https://reachorion.net/#archive): Luxury Real Estate Architectural Flagship engineered with Payload CMS 3.0 and sub-second response times.
- [The Rotunda Royale Tower](https://reachorion.net/#archive): High-density luxury CAD blueprint portal powered by Contentful Enterprise and vector floorplans.
